body:
Dear friend,

Snow is falling on the farm! It's beautiful, but the nights will be very cold now.

The sheep must come into the barn tonight. Would you help me share them out among the pens?
summary: Help Mrs. Hannah bring the sheep into the barn.
done: The sheep are snug in the barn!

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (take the map)
at the coop by your house
